clips.title: The story
paras: In Dun Morogh, Rejold Barleybrew sends a barrel of Shimmer Stout to the mountain watch. The experimental ale is meant for guards on the high passes, and drinkers say it brightens their vision.

Rejold Barleybrew brewed Shimmer Stout after gathering ingredients across Dun Morogh. The recipe is the latest work of the Barleybrew family, whose dwarven brewers compete to make hearty ales against the mountain cold. Rejold made this stout to warm the gut and sharpen the senses of those posted in the wind.

This barrel is bound for Mountaineer Wellart Barleybrew at the southern tower on the pass into Loch Modan. Mountaineers there endure cold and long watches between skirmishes with troggs and wildlife. A cask of family ale brings a taste of home, and its kick can leave a tired sentry feeling able to see clearly in the dark.
